careTeaser.heading: Keep Your Network Healthy
careTeaser.text: 24/7 automated monitoring for Internet, firewall, switches, Wi-Fi and VPN, with configuration backups and monthly health reports. Engineer review is included on higher plans.

help.heading: What Problem Are You Trying to Solve?

items.title: Wi-Fi Slow or Dropping?
items.text: Dead zones, frozen video calls, or devices that cling to the wrong access point—we find whether it is coverage, capacity, interference, switching, or the Internet line.

items.title: Setting Up or Moving an Office
items.text: ISP timing, cabling, rack and UPS readiness, Wi-Fi, VPN, and move-day testing planned before your team arrives.

items.title: VPN or Remote Access Unreliable
items.text: Slow VPN, dropped connections, or shared logins—we review the firewall, access rules, MFA, and safer remote-access options.

items.title: Worried About Firewall & Guest Wi-Fi?
items.text: Guest, POS, camera, and office devices should not all share one flat network. We check segmentation and who can still get in remotely.

items.title: Need Backup Internet?
items.text: If the main line fails, can you still take payments and use cloud apps? We design dual-ISP or 5G/LTE failover—and test it.

items.title: Want Someone Watching the Network
items.text: 24/7 automated monitoring, configuration backups, firmware alerts, and monthly health reporting—without hiring an in-house network engineer.
